description.en: The domain name of which you want to verify the ownership. You can specify only one domain name.

description.zh:
校验方式，取值：

- **dnsCheck**：DNS验证。
- **fileCheck**：文件验证。
description.en:
The verification method. Valid values:

- **dnsCheck**: by DNS record

- **fileCheck**: by verification file

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to 100 times per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn verify-domain-owner --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --region cn-hangzhou
